notes: Priya wants the carrier narrative airtight before it goes anywhere, and specifically wants to know whether Albion Parcel's November collapse is a localized, fixable problem (one hub/country/merchant) versus Landfall Freight and Lowlands Express being broadly, chronically weak (a relationship-ending problem). That's priority #1 and it needs its own evidence on both the destination side (country/region) and the origin side (warehouse/hub), split into the pre-collapse baseline (Jan-Oct) vs. the collapse window (Nov-Dec) for Albion specifically. I'm spending all 3 slots tonight on that, since getting this distinction right shapes two very different conversations with carrier partners. I'll tackle priority #2 (the reliability "ceiling" if weak carriers matched good ones) first thing tomorrow night, using a full-year, non-truncated carrier table I don't yet have cleanly. Priority #3 (clean PO backlog view) and #4 (picking discrepancies vs. delivery) will follow later this week as time allows, per Priya's own prioritization.

requests.title: Albion Parcel performance by destination country, baseline vs collapse
requests.question: Is Albion Parcel's November-December breakdown concentrated in specific destination countries, or did it hit all regions roughly equally?
requests.grain: one row per destination country and period, for Albion Parcel shipments only
columns: avg_transit_days (shipped_at to delivered_at, delivered subset only)
share_of_period_shipments_pct (this country's shipments / all Albion shipments in that period, x100)
requests.details: Tables: shipments (carrier='Albion Parcel', shipped_at, delivered_at) joined via fulfillments (fulfillment_id) -> orders (order_id) -> addresses (orders.shipping_address_id) -> countries (destination country name). transit_days = DATEDIFF(day, shipped_at, delivered_at), delivered subset only. Round avg_transit_days to 2 decimals, pct columns to 1 decimal. Include only countries with at least 15 shipments in at least one of the two periods (to avoid noise from one-off destinations). Order by destination_country ascending, then period (baseline before collapse).
builds_on: Albion Parcel transit performance by month, 2025

requests.title: Albion Parcel performance by origin warehouse, baseline vs collapse
requests.question: Is Albion Parcel's November-December breakdown concentrated in a specific warehouse/hub (or the merchants it serves), or did it hit all origins roughly equally?
requests.grain: one row per origin warehouse and period, for Albion Parcel shipments only
columns: share_of_period_shipments_pct (this warehouse's shipments / all Albion shipments in that period, x100)
requests.details: Tables: shipments (carrier='Albion Parcel', shipped_at, delivered_at) joined via fulfillments (fulfillment_id, warehouse_id) -> warehouses (name, tenant_id) -> tenants (name). Same transit_days definition as the destination-country report. Round avg_transit_days to 2 decimals, pct columns to 1 decimal. Include only warehouses with at least 10 shipments in at least one of the two periods. Order by warehouse_name ascending, then period (baseline before collapse).
builds_on: Albion Parcel transit performance by month, 2025

requests.title: Landfall Freight & Lowlands Express performance by destination country, full year 2025
requests.question: Are our two chronically weak carriers bad everywhere, or concentrated on specific lanes/countries?
requests.grain: one row per carrier and destination country (Landfall Freight and Lowlands Express only), full year 2025
columns: share_of_carrier_shipments_pct (this country's shipments / that carrier's total 2025 shipments, x100)
requests.details: Tables: shipments (carrier in ('Landfall Freight','Lowlands Express'), shipped_at between 2025-01-01 and 2025-12-31, delivered_at) joined via fulfillments -> orders -> addresses (shipping_address_id) -> countries. transit_days = DATEDIFF(day, shipped_at, delivered_at), delivered subset only. Round avg_transit_days to 2 decimals, pct columns to 1 decimal. Include only countries with at least 15 shipments for that carrier in the year. Order by carrier ascending, then shipments_shipped descending.
